title: Bind authenticated peers across message adapters
description: Audit finds Python SecureDatagramChannel verifies/decrypts but dispatches only bytes/source; LichenTransport reconstructs remote without context metadata required by messaging authorization. C coap_oscore resource lookup derives peer from routable source low64 bits, conflicting with upstream AddrForKey. Rust resolves origin through key tables. Need peer-evidence/context mapping through existing public boundaries before authenticated receipt acceptance. Preserve actual auth/replay checks; OSCORE/EDHOC security-semantic changes require human-only review and must not be implemented as blind integration fixes.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated full endpoint identity survives receive adapters and is available to messaging/receipt handlers; wrong-peer/forged metadata rejected using real protection paths; human-only boundary adjudicated before sensitive changes.
notes: COMPLETE scoped endpoint-binding implementation after user approved both adapter and necessary C lifetime extension. Python immutable per-datagram authenticated evidence passes451 focused tests; lead reran15 evidence cases. C full-address key lookup/atomic context binding/reference-safe responses passes180 distinct native_sim tests and15 final inbox/fallback cases; lifecycle9 pass. Review findings .2.1/.2.2/.2.3 fixed, final3 reviews clear. Full6-way messaging remains incomplete under oa51; no app delivery claim. All implementation source uncommitted.
close_reason: Approved C and Python endpoint evidence adapters implemented and lifetime review findings resolved.
